about.description:
A tree-sitter parser for templating languages like ERB and EJS,
in which scripting code can be embedded within text content using
the delimiters <% and %>
about.summary: A tree-sitter parser for templating languages like ERB and EJS.

build.script:
${{ PYTHON }} -m pip install . --no-deps --ignore-installed --no-build-isolation -vv

# setuptools names a py_limited_api (abi3) extension from the first '.abi3'
# entry of the BUILD interpreter's importlib.machinery.EXTENSION_SUFFIXES
# (see get_abi3_suffix() in setuptools/command/build_ext.py). CPython 3.15
# (gh-122931) inserted a platform-tagged '.abi3-<multiarch>.so' ahead of the
# plain '.abi3.so', so on a cross build the BUILD arch leaks into the
# filename and the module cannot be imported on the host. EXT_SUFFIX and
# SETUPTOOLS_EXT_SUFFIX do not govern this path.
# Rename the platform-tagged file back to the plain '.abi3.so', which every
# non-free-threaded CPython accepts. Only platform-tagged names are matched:
# on Python < 3.15 setuptools already emits the plain name and this loop is
# a no-op. crossenv >=1.6.0 emits the plain name too, so this can be dropped
# once https://github.com/conda-forge/crossenv-feedstock/pull/49 lands.
if [ "${CONDA_BUILD_CROSS_COMPILATION:-0}" = "1" ]; then
  for _f in "${PREFIX}"/lib/python*/site-packages/tree_sitter_embedded_template/_binding.abi3-*.so; do
    [ -e "${_f}" ] || continue
    _want="$(dirname "${_f}")/_binding.abi3.so"
    echo "cross-build: renaming $(basename "${_f}") -> $(basename "${_want}")"
    mv -f "${_f}" "${_want}"
  done
fi

raw_meta_yaml:
context:
  name: tree-sitter-embedded-template
  version: "0.25.0"

package:
  name: ${{ name|lower }}
  version: ${{ version }}

source:
  url: https://github.com/tree-sitter/tree-sitter-embedded-template/archive/refs/tags/v${{ version }}.tar.gz
  sha256: c45330d6c53b64c9dfbcb00e85ddb5b3f79e0f3457bc76ca764c57630ee4df54
  # Source missing file tree_sitter/parser.h
  # url: https://pypi.org/packages/source/t/tree-sitter-embedded-template/tree_sitter_embedded_template-${{ version }}.tar.gz
  # sha256: 7b24dcf2e92497f54323e617564d36866230a8bfb719dbb7b45b461510dcddaa

build:
  script:
    - if: unix
      then:
        - |
          ${{ PYTHON }} -m pip install . --no-deps --ignore-installed --no-build-isolation -vv
          
          # setuptools names a py_limited_api (abi3) extension from the first '.abi3'
          # entry of the BUILD interpreter's importlib.machinery.EXTENSION_SUFFIXES
          # (see get_abi3_suffix() in setuptools/command/build_ext.py). CPython 3.15
          # (gh-122931) inserted a platform-tagged '.abi3-<multiarch>.so' ahead of the
          # plain '.abi3.so', so on a cross build the BUILD arch leaks into the
          # filename and the module cannot be imported on the host. EXT_SUFFIX and
          # SETUPTOOLS_EXT_SUFFIX do not govern this path.
          # Rename the platform-tagged file back to the plain '.abi3.so', which every
          # non-free-threaded CPython accepts. Only platform-tagged names are matched:
          # on Python < 3.15 setuptools already emits the plain name and this loop is
          # a no-op. crossenv >=1.6.0 emits the plain name too, so this can be dropped
          # once https://github.com/conda-forge/crossenv-feedstock/pull/49 lands.
          if [ "${CONDA_BUILD_CROSS_COMPILATION:-0}" = "1" ]; then
            for _f in "${PREFIX}"/lib/python*/site-packages/tree_sitter_embedded_template/_binding.abi3-*.so; do
              [ -e "${_f}" ] || continue
              _want="$(dirname "${_f}")/_binding.abi3.so"
              echo "cross-build: renaming $(basename "${_f}") -> $(basename "${_want}")"
              mv -f "${_f}" "${_want}"
            done
          fi
    - if: win
      then:
        - ${{ PYTHON }} -m pip install . --no-deps --ignore-installed --no-build-isolation -vv
  number: 4

requirements:
  build:
    - ${{ compiler("c") }}
    - ${{ stdlib("c") }}
    - if: target_platform != build_platform
      then:
        - cross-python_${{ target_platform }}
        - python
  host:
    - pip
    - python
    - setuptools >=42
  run:
    - python

tests:
  - python:
      imports:
        - tree_sitter_embedded_template
      pip_check: true
  - script:
      - python -m pytest bindings/python/tests/
    requirements:
      run:
        - pytest
        - python
        - tree_sitter
    files:
      source:
        - bindings/python/tests/

about:
  homepage: https://github.com/tree-sitter/tree-sitter-embedded-template
  summary: 'A tree-sitter parser for templating languages like ERB and EJS.'
  description: |
    A tree-sitter parser for templating languages like ERB and EJS,
    in which scripting code can be embedded within text content using
    the delimiters <% and %>
  license: MIT
  license_file: LICENSE
  repository: https://github.com/tree-sitter/tree-sitter-embedded-template

extra:
  recipe-maintainers:
    - MementoRC
